features.feature: Approved dynamic-validation design record remains byte-integrity bound, preserves Sections 1 through 27.6, and keeps DYN-1 observe-only separate from DYN-3 authority.
Current-main validation inventory is discovered and frozen with a stable command identity digest; historical 107/110 counts are non-authoritative.
Canonical Story change manifest and dual-revision impact graph cover additions, modifications, deletions, renames, reverse dependents, process facts, capabilities, and scope escalation.
Every validation command has a catalog policy, source/runtime closure certificate, risk and resource data, and valid fact/capability bindings.
Deterministic additive selection produces execute, admissible reuse, and fail-closed escalation rows with complete inventory accounting and signed manifests.
Observe mode records selection and comparison while the unchanged complete validation plan remains the sole authority.
Source-first DYN-2 execution produces signed per-command receipts and canonical baselines bound to build, closure, ancestry, epoch, tree, expiry, and revocation facts.
Shadow reuse is compared with the complete-plan oracle and cannot claim TEST or DONE authority.
DYN-3 low-risk dynamic TEST authority is fail-closed behind all blocking prerequisites and falls back to complete validation when any prerequisite is not admissible.
Operators receive dynamic-validation modes, structured observability, honest performance populations, non-destructive rollback, and preserved evidence history.
Historical replay, FI-1 through FI-5, mutation, and enforcement evidence cover false-negative, receipt, closure, rename/delete, and authority risks.
DYN-4 weighted LPT scheduling respects CPU, resource claims, exclusivity, drain barriers, order, cleanup, and serial equivalence.
DYN-5 quorum and review-pass sharding executes stable cases exactly once with real sentinels, signed receipts, exact aggregation, routing checks, and zero residue.
Wave 4 acceptance topology, pre-review, rollout report, and rollout admission checks are verifier-owned and bound to current-head evidence.
The complete current inventory remains the denominator; execute plus admissible reuse must cover every row with no unverified, uncovered, or unmapped row.
Uncertainty, stale or malformed evidence, protected or unmapped changes, and incomplete closures fail closed to execution or complete-plan escalation.
Full validation remains the fallback, periodic baseline, and audit oracle; focused validation and DONE-required evidence remain separate from dynamic authority.
All gate-consumed facts and artifacts are signed, digest-bound, ancestry-compatible, current, clean-tree generated, and mechanically verifiable.
The implementation remains within the declared B-45a0 scope, preserves protected and explicit-exclusion boundaries, and does not widen authority through prose or historical success.
